other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses hardcoded weights to blend model predictions. While better than an unweighted average, this approach is rigid and does not dynamically optimise weights based on the actual out-of-fold predictions using methods like ridge regression or Nelder-Mead, potentially leaving performance on the table.

summary: The agent provides a robust cross-validated solution using several gradient boosting algorithms and ExtraTrees, complete with appropriate feature engineering. However, it fails to incorporate any data cleaning steps, relying entirely on the algorithms to handle potential data issues.
